id.description: Managed object reference ID of the created virtual machine.

name.description: Name of the created virtual machine.

uuid.description: BIOS UUID of the created virtual machine.

ip_address.description: Primary IP address reported by VMware Tools. Null when the guest never reported one, which is always the case if wait_for_guest_ip_timeout is 0.

ip_addresses.description: All IP addresses reported by VMware Tools for the created virtual machine.
